component.name: ChessReader
component.summary: High-performance Chess PGN Viewer, Editor, and Annotator for Linux

description.p: ChessReader combines industrial-strength chess logic with the distraction-free, hyper-minimal aesthetic of the Zed Editor.

ul.li: Unified Client-Side Decoration (CSD) headerbar with dynamic breadcrumb navigation.
Monospace indented move tree view for recursive variation trees (RAVs).
Built-in asynchronous Stockfish 18 UCI engine with live Multi-PV candidate lines and evaluation bar.
Custom piece and board theme loading system with high-DPI caching.
Interactive keyboard-driven workflow with Ctrl+K Command Palette and FEN position editor.
